authorization: Latest FULL AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH MANDATE authorizes finite independent prospective model/task choices and local execution within cumulative limits. No invented human approval timestamp; historical freezes and pending review remain binding for their own claims.
question: Does authentic earlier cross-conversation History improve recognition of a speaker's actually observed next utterance relative to a matched other speaker's History, beyond a common six-turn current context? How stable is the chosen content under reversing the two options?
rationale: Previous length-excluded surface-style proxy had weak human positive-control discrimination. This study uses exact corpus provenance as an objective recognition target, not that proxy and not an automatic substitute for semantic judgments. Both alternatives can be appropriate utterances; recognition is not dialogue quality, factual truth, behavioral fidelity or semantic correctness.
scope: Three external-history arms with S numeric instructions absent and F explicit profiles absent. Current six-turn dialogue context is fixed in all arms: NONE is not a genuine H=0 condition. This is not a new full S/F/H factorial.
selection: Deterministic hashed development-only selection in the existing76-speaker cohort. Exclude all target dialogues used in either prior real-speaker generation study. Reciprocal pairs use each person's true target as the other's alternative, so each exact text is a target and a foil. No reserved58 speaker content decoded. Both external histories precede both target dialogues and have six authentic turns, distinct source/target partners and disjoint within-pair participant sets. Same speaker cannot enter two pairs. Candidate length ratio <=1.25 and absolute normalized character difference <=8. Both candidates pass direct-copy exclusion against both contexts and both histories. No outcome-based sample replacement or relaxation.
history_matching: Match labelled six-turn source blocks within8 native tokens before generation; full CORRECT versus MISMATCH prompts must also differ by at most8 tokens. No synthetic neutral padding or arbitrary textual truncation. Record exact differences. This reduces length imbalance but does not isolate pure speaker identity from topic/content differences.
order: For each speaker, each of three arms is presented in both option orders; cyclic arm order by speaker and reversed cycle for second presentation. Actual target position is balanced within every case and arm. All repetitions are prospectively allocated order manipulations, not retries.
model_selection: One official Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 configuration selected before any new response, for native multilingual non-thinking support, official distribution lineage and feasible memory. This is a new low-memory developmental configuration, not a repair or requalification of prior2B/Candidate2 runs. Smaller size does not imply adequate persona capability.
decoding_rationale: Greedy non-thinking decisions isolate deterministic option-order effects and bound CPU cost; they are a disclosed task-specific departure from the model card's general sampled-decoding recommendation, not claimed optimal dialogue generation settings. No grammar masking hides format failures.
control_gate: Four authored Japanese literal-selection requests (two statements, both A/B orders) must all yield the correct single ASCII letter after surrounding whitespace removal. These controls establish only minimal language/format operation, not universal model feasibility or persona quality. On any failure complete only the already allocated four controls, preserve all outputs, and stop before main48. No retries, prompt repairs or alternate-model search on these cases.

scoring.parser: Strip surrounding whitespace only. Exact A or B is a valid selection; no aliases, substring extraction or post-hoc semantic repair. Invalid returned text is a failed protocol response, with selection identity missing, not labelled semantically incorrect.
scoring.primary: Observed-continuation protocol success: valid A/B equals the archived actual next-utterance option. Report its all-returned mean alongside format coverage and valid-selection-only recognition; failed/unattempted calls stay missing with allocation bounds, not silently zeroed.
scoring.dependence: Average two orders per case, two reciprocal cases per pair, then four pairs equally. Pair is the dependence cluster because candidate strings are shared. Report complete-pair counts, all-allocation [-1,1] contrast bounds, pairwise effects and leave-one-pair-out means; no p values or calibrated confidence intervals.
scoring.position_invariance: Among pairs of returned valid choices for the same case/arm, determine whether the same candidate text is chosen after A/B reversal. Report coverage and first-option frequency separately; do not call invariance semantic correctness.
scoring.baseline: Fixed normalized character-trigram Jaccard retrieval on the identical available context/history and candidates, ties receive0.5. No tuned vocabulary, learning or oracle reference text outside the two explicitly supplied alternatives. Also report the0.5 constant-position baseline induced by paired option orders.
scoring.cost: Record native stop reasons/token counts, wall-clock completion latency as observed CPU-run latency (not process CPU time), system available RAM and server working set. No EOS-to-semantic-completeness inference.

memory_rationale: New639446688-byte Q8 model,2048-token context. F16 KV upper allocation from28 layers*2048tokens*8KVheads*128dimensions*2(K,V)*2bytes=234881024bytes. Combined weights+KV874327712bytes leaves~1.27GB of the2GiB prelaunch threshold for compute/runtime overhead and the512MiB live reserve; actual1GiB ready and512MiB per-request gates still apply. Estimate is not a memory guarantee. Never lower old3/4/5GiB configuration thresholds or terminate unrelated apps.
stopping: Stop on integrity, hardware, time or accounting violation; preserve attempts and unattempted allocation. No automatic second run or outcome-contingent resumption. If insufficient material matches or Japanese controls fail, preserve that negative branch rather than relax rules.
privacy: Local-only pseudonymous study under the existing pinnedRPC license/privacy assessment; no external inference, participant identification, demographic/personality inference, impersonation, row-level release or fabricated consent. Neither target nor foil is labelled as a morally/semantically wrong human response.
validation: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Preserve58 held-out speakers. No independence claim from reuse of the development corpus, paired repeated decisions, or independent arithmetic reproduction. No automatic expansion into a validation cohort.
algorithm: History selection and lexical retrieval are established baselines. Only reproducible, interpretable failures could justify a later separately registered intervention; no algorithm novelty claim in this study.
